messages:
Ellen (Docs): CI popped a bunch of linkcheck failures after yesterday's content tidy. Broken fragment: /reference/cli#common-commands-1
DeployBot: docs-ci | LINKCHECK FAILED -> /reference/cli#common-commands-1 (404)
Ellen (Docs): weird, the heading in reference/cli.md is '## Common commands' (only once in file). why is there a -1 suffix in the fragment?
Connor (Eng): looks like we used to have two headings named 'Common commands' across the site; slug dedupe previously used suffixes, but the new slugifier changed the dedupe ordering so the canonical slug moved to a different page, leaving some internal links pointing at the old numerated anchor (#common-commands-1) which no longer exists on this page
Marta (DevEx): ah — that's nasty because external bookmarks and our quickstart link from the README point at the old suffixed fragment. Short-term we should add an explicit id to the heading so both variants resolve.
Ravi (Tech Writer): proposed patch: \n```md
## Common commands {#common-commands}
```
Ravi (Tech Writer): and add a redirect mapping to cover the legacy suffixed fragment: \n```js
// docusaurus client redirects
['@docusaurus/plugin-client-redirects', {
  redirects: [
    { to: '/reference/cli#common-commands', from: ['/reference/cli#common-commands-1'] }
  ]
}]
```
Connor (Eng): I'll open a single PR to: 1) add the explicit id, 2) add redirect, 3) update README link to point at explicit id. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/7211 (draft)
Ellen (Docs): can we also add a short test to linkcheck that detects when slug dedupe changed across the corpus? maybe warn if any fragment ends with -1, -2 etc and surface the owning page so we can audit
Marta (DevEx): good idea. I'll add a warning rule: scan all generated fragments for numbered suffixes, list them in the CI summary, and fail only if the target fragment is missing. That should help us find other fragile anchors
Ravi (Tech Writer): I'll also grep for internal links containing '#common-commands-1' and update any we control. External links we can't change, hence the redirects
DeployBot: PR 7211 | checks started
Connor (Eng): PR updated with explanatory comment about slug dedupe churn and a link to docs/migration/slug-dedupe-notes.md
Ellen (Docs): after merge let's run the traffic audit for top 50 inbound fragment hits and prioritize explicit ids for the high-traffic ones
Connor (Eng): merged and deployed, CI green. redirects in place.
DeployBot: docs site build | SUCCESS
Ellen (Docs): closing the loop. followups: 1) add CI warning rule for numbered slugs, 2) audit top inbound fragments next week, 3) add migration note for slug dedupe behavior
Marta (DevEx): noted. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
